Subject: Airlock deployment Q&A — Orion Health RFP

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the RFP submission so far. We have a small set of clarifying questions specific to the air-gapped / private deployment (section B of the RFP). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following evidence or posture statements?

1) KMS/HSM integration approach for an air-gapped VPC: architecture diagram + list of supported vendors.
2) Offline patching process and rollback playbook for nodes that cannot reach internet mirrors.
3) SBOM export and third-party component attestation for the deployed runtime image.
4) Evidence of secure supply-chain controls (signed builds, reproducible artifacts).
5) Example runbook for emergency data export/forensics from an isolated deployment.

We attached Appendix B with the official RFP checklist — please reference it and send a consolidated evidence pack and named artifacts. Ideally we'd like a first pass by next Wednesday (2026-09-23).

Appreciate it,

Michael Taylor
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Orion Health Systems
procurement@orionhealth.com

Michael — thanks for the clear list. We can provide an evidence pack that maps directly to Appendix B items. High-level answers inline; we'll follow up with artifacts attached.

- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS in VPC (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and HSM integrations via on-prem PKCS#11 bridges for air-gapped installs. Diagram attached.
- Offline patching: We maintain an offline patch bundle process (signed delta packages) plus a rollback snapshot approach; runbook excerpt will be included.
- SBOM/export: We can export SBOMs (CycloneDX) for runtime images and provide attestations for third-party deps.
- Supply chain: Builds are reproducible and signed; we'll provide our build-signing policy and verification artifacts.
- Forensics/runbook: We'll include an example emergency export play (playbook + checklist).

We've attached: Redwood_Airlock_QA_v1.pdf (answers mapped to Appendix B) and network_diagram_v2.png. Diego will provide the runbook snapshot and the signed SBOM. Expect a consolidated package by 2026-09-29.

Regards,

Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Ava — thanks for the quick response and the initial attachments. A couple of follow-ups after a quick review (copied Sarah who owns final security signoff):

- For HSM support: can you specify whether the on-prem PKCS#11 bridge requires outbound connectivity for key rotation, or whether rotation can be handled entirely inside the isolated network? If outbound is required, we need mitigations.
- Offline patching: can you point to the last time an isolated deploy was patched and validated in field? Any audit notes or evidence from a customer install would be helpful.
- SBOM: we'd like an example CycloneDX XML + verification steps you use during install. Also, how do you handle transitive dependencies that are licensed differently?
- Supply chain: please include the GPG signature file for the most recent runtime build (or a signing certificate thumbprint).

Can you include these in the consolidated package? Sarah — if you have any additional items, please flag.

On Wed, Sep 23, 2026 Ava wrote:
> Michael — thanks for the clear list. We can provide an evidence pack that maps directly to Appendix B items.

Best,
Michael

Michael / Sarah — attaching the consolidated evidence pack addressing your follow-ups. Summary of included artifacts below and a short note on each.

Attachments in this email (all zip/tar-friendly artifacts):
- Redwood_Airlock_QA_v1.pdf (PDF) — consolidated answers mapped to Appendix B and the follow-ups from 09/24.
- network_diagram_v2.png (PNG) — updated network diagram showing optional KMS bridge placement.
- runbook_snapshot.docx (DOCX) — excerpt of emergency export + offline patch play; includes checklist and rollback steps.
- runtime_sbom_cyclonedx.xml (XML) — sample CycloneDX SBOM for the runtime (truncated for share).
- runtime_build_signature.asc (ASCII) — GPG detached signature for the referenced build.

Quick notes:
- HSM/PKCS#11: The PKCS#11 bridge can operate fully inside the air-gapped VPC for key rotation. Outbound connectivity is not required for rotation; remote rotation automation can be configured optionally via an admin jumpbox with temporary egress and audited transfer approvals. The diagram shows both options.
- Offline patching: We provided a recent field case (redacted) where our on-prem team delivered an offline patch bundle to a regulated customer (date: 2026-06-12); runbook excerpt includes validation and signed rollback snapshots.
- SBOM & transitive deps: SBOM includes transitive component entries and license metadata; our install checklist forces license review gates for any non-compatible license types.
- Signed builds: runtime_build_signature.asc is the detached signature; our public verification key fingerprint is: 3A5B C1F0 9D4E 7F21 88A9 5C2D 4F4B A6E1 9F2A 0B3C

If this looks complete, we can package the same artifacts into a secure transfer (SFTP + signed manifest) or provide an edge USB transfer under NDA for air-gapped acceptance testing. Let us know your preference and any additional required formats.

Thanks — cc'ing Vanessa and Diego who assembled the technical artifacts.
